synth.notes:
Twin colour-10 4x4 blocks: A1/A2 y-/+4, A3 apart / A4 together, mirrored by side (centre<32).
A move succeeds iff the destination 4x4 is floor colour 5 (own cells excepted) in rows 1-62; walls 15/8 read from frame.
Click inactive marker 9 arms (blocks->1, marker->11, others back to 9); click player 1 disarms; armed A1-A4 move active marker's 4x4 cell.
HUD: colour-0 bar at row 0 from right and row 63 from left, width (128a+150)//300, a = actions this level, memo of returned frames.
Unconfirmed: level-reset trigger (not observed); stateless fallback a = largest a for bar width, 0 if no bar.
